sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.price * o.quantity_product), 0) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o JOIN product p ON p.product_id = o.product_id WHERE o.date >= '2026-03-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.price * o.quantity_product), 0) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o JOIN product p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.birth_date >= '2000-09-26' AND c.birth_date <= '2001-09-25'
